purpose: Determine whether an official stock series can serve as the lagged denominator for announced RON auction supply without silently widening the market, sector, currency or valuation boundary.

numerator_boundary.concept: announced RON amount in Ministry domestic primary-market auctions

denominator_candidates.source: Monthly public debt report — holdings of government securities denominated in LEI issued on domestic market
denominator_candidates.instrument_boundary: government securities issued on domestic market
strengths: same official Ministry reporting family as the auction data
nominal-value stock is dimensionally compatible with announced nominal auction amounts
blockers: the public report does not define the holdings table as exactly the interbank-auction universe
retail and other domestic-market security coverage relative to the auction universe is not explicitly reconciled in the reviewed source
the broader all-currency holdings total and the Flash current-outstanding presentation use different boundaries/figures

strengths: explicit statistical sector and instrument boundary
blockers: market-value stock is not directly commensurate with nominal announced auction amounts
covers central-government debt securities across issuance channels rather than the exact Ministry interbank-auction universe
would require a preregistered valuation/boundary bridge before use as a supply-load denominator

strengths: face-value stock is valuation-compatible with nominal announced supply
maturity and currency breakdowns are available in the GFS family
blockers: S13 general-government boundary is broader than Ministry central-government auction issuance
not definitionally restricted to the domestic interbank primary-market universe
requires exact series-key selection and source-vintage retention before numerical comparison

flash_report_consistency_check.source: Public Debt of Romania — Flash Report, January 2025
flash_report_consistency_check.effect: The Flash headline is not used to override the internally coherent monthly-report holdings tables.

next_task.scope: Proceed with the exact announced-RON primary-supply reference mode without selecting a stock denominator. Retain denominator candidates only for named sensitivity/capacity diagnostics.
